title: Response-path identifiability and conditional hydraulic-exposure audit

primary_path_gate.metric: complete-terminal-tree OOF station Spearman between model Q2 volume fraction and three-method Q-derived BFI median

sensitivity_set: R1 hydraulic routing without land refit

hydraulic_exposure.equation: tau = reach_length * Andreadis bankfull_width * bankfull_depth / candidate-own routed discharge
hydraulic_exposure.role: diagnostic only because R1 failed Stage 4 and every Stage 5 nested route decision
hydraulic_exposure.geometry_uncertainty: use width/depth p05 and p95 bounds

forbidden: claim observed groundwater, new water, old water, or water age
